info.title: AMC Scheduler Service
info.description:
eGov DIGIT platform service that manages Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) configurations, the assets covered under those contracts, and the scheduled maintenance visits generated from a configuration.

### Authentication
This API does **not** use an `Authorization` HTTP header. Every request body carries a `RequestInfo` object, and authentication is performed via `RequestInfo.authToken` (the Bearer JWT issued by egov-user) together with `RequestInfo.userInfo` (the caller's user profile and roles). Obtain `authToken` by logging in through egov-user's `/user/oauth/token` or `/user/_login` API, then place the returned token as the value of `RequestInfo.authToken` on every subsequent call. Requests with a missing/invalid/expired token are rejected (401/403) by the platform's auth filter before reaching this service's business logic.

All list-based request/response wrappers (`AssetAmcs`, `AmcConfigurations`, `ScheduledVisits`) and the `ResponseInfo` envelope follow standard DIGIT platform conventions.

servers.description: Server context-path as configured in src/main/resources/application.properties (server.servlet.context-path=/asset-amc)

tags.name: AssetAmc
tags.description: APIs to create, update and search Asset-AMC linkage records (which asset is covered under which AMC configuration).

tags.name: ScheduledVisit
tags.description: APIs to create, generate, update (including workflow transitions) and search scheduled maintenance visits, plus OTP resend for visit-report submission.

tags.name: AmcConfiguration
tags.description: APIs to create, update and search AMC configuration records (vendor, facility, project, duration, visit frequency and assignments).

post.description: Capture details of asset(s) covered under an AMC configuration ("Capture details of benificiary type." per controller ApiParam). At least one AssetAmc entry is required.

202.description: Accepted. AssetAmc creation request accepted and persisted; enriched records (with generated ids and auditDetails) are returned.

post.description: Details for the updated Field Plan (per controller ApiParam) - update one or more existing AssetAmc records identified by their id.
Details for the assetAmc (per controller ApiParam) - search AssetAmc records by tenantId, ids, assetIds, amcConfigurationIds, statuses and date ranges, with pagination.

200.description: OK. Matching AssetAmc records with total count.

post.description: Capture details of scheduled visit(s) (per controller ApiParam). At least one ScheduledVisit entry is required.

post.summary: Generate scheduled visits for an AMC configuration
post.description: Generates ScheduledVisit records for the given AMC configuration based on its duration and visit frequency, optionally scoped to a generation date window and optionally regenerating existing visits.

202.description: Accepted. Scheduled visits generated for the configuration.

400.description: Bad Request - e.g. configurationId missing/not found, or configuration cannot generate visits.

Errors.message: The configuration ID: c2d3e4f5-a6b7-4c8d-9e0f-1234567890cd do not exist
Errors.description: The configuration ID: c2d3e4f5-a6b7-4c8d-9e0f-1234567890cd do not exist

post.summary: Submit a visit report and transition its workflow
post.description: Details for the updated workflow visit (per controller ApiParam). Submits/updates the VisitReport for a scheduled visit (e.g. after OTP verification) and applies the workflow action/transition supplied.

200.description: OK. Scheduled visit updated with new workflow status.

400.description: Bad Request - e.g. visit report not found, invalid OTP request, or empty workflow response.

Errors.message: Visit report with OTP reference is required for SUBMIT_OTP action
Errors.description: Visit report with OTP reference is required for SUBMIT_OTP action

post.description: Details for the visit (per controller ApiParam). Search ScheduledVisit records by tenantId, ids, amcConfigurationIds, facilityIds, projectsIds, statuses, date ranges, visitNumbers and assignedUsers, with pagination. Each returned visit is additionally enriched with its workflow ProcessInstances and payment/OTP Transactions.

200.description: OK. Matching scheduled visits (enriched with processInstances and transactions) with total count.

post.summary: Resend OTP for a scheduled visit report
post.description: Capture details of scheduled visit (per controller ApiParam). Regenerates and resends the OTP used to verify visit-report submission for the given visitId, sent to the facility POC's mobile number.

200.description: OK. OTP resent; response contains OTP metadata (not the OTP value itself in production).

400.description: Bad Request - e.g. visitId missing, visit not found, or facility/employee mobile number missing for OTP generation.

Errors.message: Visit not found with ID: d2e3f4a5-b6c7-4d8e-9f0a-1234567890ab
Errors.description: Visit not found with ID: d2e3f4a5-b6c7-4d8e-9f0a-1234567890ab

post.description: Details for the updated scheduled visits (per controller ApiParam). Bulk-updates one or more existing ScheduledVisit records identified by their id.
Capture details of benificiary type (per controller ApiParam). At least one AmcConfiguration entry is required.
Details for the updated Field Plan (per controller ApiParam). Update one or more existing AmcConfiguration records identified by their id, including assignments.

Details for the amcConfiguration (per controller ApiParam). Search AmcConfiguration records by tenantId, ids, vendorIds, facilityIds, projectIds, statuses, activeOnDate, date range, assignedUsers and createdBy, with pagination.

200.description: OK. Matching AMC configurations with total count.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

includeDeleted.name: includeDeleted
includeDeleted.description: Used to fetch soft-deleted records too, if set to true.

lastChangedSince.name: lastChangedSince
lastChangedSince.description: Epoch time in milliseconds; used to fetch records changed since this timestamp.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request. Typically raised as a `org.egov.tracer.model.CustomException` (e.g. missing mandatory field, referenced entity not found, or a validation failure) and rendered by egov-tracer's default exception handler as an `ErrorRes`.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized. `RequestInfo.authToken` is missing, invalid or expired.

Errors.description: The auth token provided in RequestInfo is invalid or has expired. Please login again via egov-user /user/oauth/token.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden. The authenticated user does not have the role/privilege required to perform this action.

Errors.description: User with roles supplied in RequestInfo.userInfo.roles is not authorized to perform this action.

NotFound.description: Not Found. The referenced resource (e.g. AssetAmc, AmcConfiguration, ScheduledVisit or a related Project/Facility/Vendor) does not exist.

Errors.message: The records that you are trying to update does not exists in the system
Errors.description: The records that you are trying to update does not exists in the system

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error. An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request.

Errors.message: Some internal error occurred while processing this request

Role.description: Role assigned to a user, as embedded in RequestInfo.userInfo.roles (org.egov.common.contract.request.Role).

UserInfo.description: User details embedded in RequestInfo.userInfo (org.egov.common.contract.request.User). This, together with RequestInfo.authToken, is how the caller is authenticated and authorized - there is no separate Authorization header.

RequestInfo.description: Standard DIGIT platform request envelope. `authToken` is the Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's /user/oauth/token or /user/_login - it is the sole authentication mechanism used by this service (no Authorization header).

authToken.description: Bearer JWT issued by egov-user's OAuth login (/user/oauth/token or /user/_login). Carries the authenticated session for this request - the platform's auth filter validates this token in place of an Authorization header.

Error.description: Single error entry (org.egov.tracer.model.Error), as produced by egov-tracer's default CustomException handler.

ErrorRes.description: Standard eGov-tracer error response shape returned (HTTP 400 by default, or the mapped status for the exception type) whenever a CustomException/validation error/unhandled exception occurs.

Document.description: Generic uploaded document reference, reused across Asset, Organisation, ProcessInstance and Workflow.

Facility.description: Facility (e.g. hospital/health centre) that an AMC configuration or scheduled visit belongs to.

Project.description: Project (org.egov.common.models.project.Project, from the health-services-models library) that an AMC configuration or scheduled visit is linked to. Shown with its most commonly used fields.

Asset.description: Registered asset (e.g. medical equipment) that may be covered under an AMC.

AmcConfigurationAssignment.description: Assignment of a user (typically a technician) to an AMC configuration.

AmcConfiguration.description: AMC configuration record linking a vendor, a facility and a project, with duration/frequency and status.

AssetAmc.description: Linkage record between an Asset and an AmcConfiguration.

EmployeeRole.description: Role assigned to an amc-scheduler-service User (org.egov.amc.web.models.Role) - distinct from the platform-wide RequestInfo Role.

AssignedUser.description: Employee/user assigned to a scheduled visit (org.egov.amc.web.models.User) - a fuller employee profile than RequestInfo.UserInfo, sourced from egov-user.

ScheduledVisitAssignment.description: Assignment of an employee to a scheduled visit.

VisitReport.description: Report captured during/after a scheduled visit, including OTP verification metadata and MDMS-driven dynamic responses.

responses.description: Dynamic key-value responses captured for the visit, schema-driven by schemaCode/version.

ProcessInstance.description: Workflow process-instance/history entry for a scheduled visit (org.egov.amc.web.models.ProcessInstance).

Transaction.description: Transaction record (e.g. OTP verification / payment) linked to a scheduled visit.

Workflow.description: Workflow action payload applied when submitting/transitioning a scheduled visit.

ScheduledVisit.description: A single maintenance visit scheduled under an AMC configuration.
List of ScheduledVisit objects (JSON property is named 'ScheduledVisit', singular, despite being an array).

otp.description: Present only in non-production/test profiles; withheld in production responses.
